name: Hungaroring
notes: Hungaroring (clockwise). Raceway loop. Traced 4314 m vs 4381 m. Start line in the middle of the pit straight. One DRS zone on the pit straight as in 2012. Values from 2012 F1: race laps, pit lane loss and overtaking are approximate. tyre_wear_mult and the wet weather multiplier are first guesses and will be tuned. speed_scale is 1.0 until the lap time calibration against the 2012 pole. pole_side is the inside of the first corner (approximate).
